<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex14022026-09-1002-48-13" status="unreviewed">
   <milestone n="b. se ston" unit="section"/>
   <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">gzhan dag</rs> <rs type="person">se ston</rs><!--Could be rGyal ba so/se ston (ID:6342), abot of gSang phu after gNyal zhig (ID:3887), or ID:6312--> ni chos nyid dang <expan>ye shes</expan> sngar ma mthong ba mngon suM du mthong ba yin no zhes smra la | 
   <milestone n="c. gnyal" unit="section"/>
   <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">la la</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3887">gnyal</rs></note><!--gNyal zhig?--> ni bdag med pa'am rang bzhin med pa sngar <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="44a2"/> ma mthong ba mngon sum du mthong ba'o zhes brjod cing | 
   <milestone n="d. rtsang 'bre" unit="section"/>
   <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3872">gzhan</rs> ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3872">rtsang 'bre</rs></note> <expan>'jig rten</expan> chos mchog gi mjug thog tu mi dmigs pa'i shes rab ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs ldan no zhes zer ro ||
   <milestone n="e. ston skyabs" unit="section"/>
   <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3864">'ga' zhig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">ston skyabs</rs></note> 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam ma skyes kyi gong du de kho na nyid mngon suM du rtogs pa'o zhes <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="44a3"/> grag go |</seg></TEI>
